title: Vanilla+ Multiplayer
description: Ever wanted to play one of those Vanilla+ Packs, but couldn't play with your friends? Well, now you can!
body:
# Welcome!
Welcome to Vanilla+ Multiplayer, a simple modpack which aims to improve the experience of Minecraft, whilst keeping it similar to the Vanilla game. There are plenty of tweaks to make your game as smooth sailing as possible, so let's jump in!

# Features
- Huge FPS Boost (up to 4x the Vanilla client during testing);
- Subtle but helpful QoL features;
- Full shader support (Complementary Unbound included);
- Fully configurable mod options;
- Optifine-like Zoom
- & much, much more!

# Experiencing Issues?
If you're facing any problems with my modpack, nobody's happy. Feel free to contact me over at `toby@tobezdev.com` - make sure to provide as much information as you can so that I can assist you as quickly as possible! :D

_I'm very aware there's a section to add a bug tracker link and similar stuff, but, to be honest, I find email much easier. I can always change it later if that would work better anyways._

--
